enable_dhcp_source.description: Enable fetching NTP servers via DHCP option 120 (requires dhcpcd with --request-option 120 support).

interface.description: Network interface to use for DHCP request (empty = all interfaces).

allow_lan_clients.description: Allow NTP queries from LAN subnets (must specify at least one subnet in lan_subnets).

lan_subnets.description: List of IPv4/IPv6 subnets (CIDR notation) allowed to query this NTP server.

items.description: A subnet in CIDR notation, e.g., '192.168.1.0/24' or 'fd00::/64'.

log_dir.description: Directory where chronyd writes log files.

max_log_lines.description: Maximum number of log lines to keep per file before rotation.

drift_file.description: Path to the file storing the system clock drift.

makestep_threshold.description: Step the clock if offset exceeds this value (in seconds), before max_steps have elapsed.

max_steps.description: Maximum number of steps allowed before switching to slew-only mode.

keyfile_path.description: Path to the file containing NTP authentication keys.

enable_hwtimestamp.description: Enable hardware timestamping support on all network interfaces (requires hardware support).

static_servers.description: Static NTP servers used as fallback (e.g., when DHCP is unavailable).

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the NTP server.
